payload.name: mcp-gdrive-gmail-enrollment
payload.goal: Deliver minimum viable MCP integration for Google Drive and Gmail: multi-account enrollment mutualized via h2a, workspace-segmented re-exposure, using existing sentropic connectors. MCP lane builds only the mcp-platform seam; architect owns api/tenancy/migrations decisions.

payload.note: Iteration 1. Verified in code: mcp-platform already supports multi-account + workspace segmentation (ConnectorEnrollment id/tenantRef/workspaceRef/secretRefs, StpConnectorContext.getSecret by reference, AppConnectorProviderAdapter). Sole blocker is api-side: document_connector_accounts has UNIQUE(workspace_id,user_id,provider) and provider CHECK limited to google_drive; no Gmail connector exists. Two pings sent to architect (latest narrows to a single yes/no decision on migration + opaque account id). Architect not live; awaiting reply. Next: start MCP-side GDrive/Gmail adapter work that is valid regardless of the migration outcome.
